H1

Intents adoption is growing sustainably

Intents volume, unique sender addresses, and returning share show genuine growth; concentration not excessive; take rate stable

5 tests · 4 kill criteria
TestDefinitionThreshold
vol_growth_90dVolume Growth (90d vs prior 90d)> 0
sender_growth_90dUnique Sender Growth (90d)> 0
returning_sender_shareReturning Sender Share>= 30%
top10_sender_shareTop-10 Sender Share< 50%
take_rate_trendTake Rate Trend (365d slope)> -25%
Kill criteria (4)ShowHide
  • Volume growth <= 0 for two consecutive 90d windows
  • Unique sender growth < 0 while volume growth > 0 (whale-driven)
  • Top-10 sender share > 50%
  • Take rate falls > 25% over window with flat fees
H2

Intents activity predicts NEAR network activity

Intents volume changes precede non-Intents NEAR active accounts/transactions changes

4 tests · 2 kill criteria
TestDefinitionThreshold
corr_pearsonPearson Correlation (lags -8 to +8)|rho| >= 0.3, FDR CI excludes 0
corr_spearmanSpearman Correlation|rho| >= 0.3, FDR CI excludes 0
partial_corrPartial Corr (market control)|rho| >= 0.3
rolling_corrRolling 26-week CorrelationVisual inspection
Kill criteria (2)ShowHide
  • No lag >= 0 meets |rho| >= 0.3 with FDR-adjusted CI excluding 0
  • n < 52 weekly observations
H3

NEAR captures meaningful value from Intents

Capture rate and net revenue show sustainable value accrual

4 tests · 4 kill criteria
TestDefinitionThreshold
capture_rateCapture Rate (90d trailing)>= 10%
net_rev_growthNet Revenue NEAR Growth> 0
take_rate_compressionTake Rate CompressionNot falling > 25% with flat fees
reconciliation3-Way Revenue ReconciliationDelta <= 25% or explained
Kill criteria (4)ShowHide
  • Capture rate < 10% over trailing 90d
  • Capture rate falls in 3 consecutive months
  • Net revenue (NEAR) declines while Intents activity increases
  • Onchain rebuild disagrees with DefiLlama by > 25% and unexplained

Post-buyback (since 2026-02-23), value capture translates to tokenholder benefit

TestDefinitionThreshold
buyback_issuanceBuyback NEAR / Net Issuance (90d)>= 10%
removal_issuanceRemoved NEAR / Net Issuance> 0

Change control

Amendments

Any changes after freeze are append-only in PREREGISTRATION.md with date, change, and rationale.

Methodology

The statistical rules that decide whether a hypothesis survives or is killed.

Statistical methodology

Statistical method

  • Stationary transforms: log-differences (log x_t - log x_t-1)
  • Primary frequency: weekly (ISO weeks)
  • Minimum n = 52 weekly observations
  • Missing weeks dropped, never interpolated

Inference

  • Stationary block bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, block length 10)
  • Benjamini–Hochberg FDR across all lags tested
  • Partial correlation controlling for BTC/ETH returns
  • Effect size + CI + n reported (never p-value alone)

Structural breaks

  • Pre/post 2026-02-23 (buyback start)
  • Exclude 14d post 2026-10-01 (exploit)
  • Results reported for each subsample

Current evidence summary

Observed coverage versus what is still required

Available now

  • DefiLlama: Intents TVL, fees, revenue, holders revenue (552 days)
  • DefiLlama: NEAR Chain TVL (1,913 days)
  • Intents Explorer: 4 days of transaction data (volume, swaps, unique sender addresses, chains, tokens, concentration)
  • NearBlocks: Revenue wallet NEAR inflows (90d), buyback outflows (0 observed)
  • Pikespeak: Top 100 hot wallets (38.9M NEAR)

Requires additional data

  • Network-wide daily active accounts / transactions
  • Intents-attributable NEAR activity
  • Net supply change / total supply / issuance
  • Historical buyback/removal trace with counterparties
  • 90-day backfill for Intents metrics (currently 4 days)

Verdicts are rule-based and are not issued until every test has the required sample size. Correlation is not described as causation.
